description: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced the programme at the Namma Shaale, Namma Javabdarievent at Vidhana Soudha on November 4. The 12-month initiative, scheduled to run from January to December 2027, will be implemented by the Head Held High Foundation in collaboration with the Department of School Education and Literacy.
body_lead: Karnataka will train 5,000 government school teachers in basic artificial intelligence (AI) literacy under the JanAI initiative, as the state seeks to build AI capabilities within its public education system and promote responsible use of the technology in classrooms.Chief Minister D.K.
